project_type: Next.js 16.3.3 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first config), Supabase backend
build_system: next build — no special quirks; turbopack is referenced in .next but the npm script just uses `next dev`
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run lint` from the repo root to check ESLint. 2. Run `npm run build` to confirm a clean production build. Both must exit with code 0 before marking a FEAT complete.
environment_constraints: sharp is installed (node_modules/sharp exists). No /public/icons/ directory exists. Existing favicon files are at /public/favicon.ico, /public/favicon-16x16.png, /public/favicon-32x32.png, /public/apple-touch-icon.png. No `next/image` API changes in Next.js 16 that affect this work — standard props (src, width, height, alt, className, priority) are all stable.
contribution_requirements: Frontend-only — do NOT touch backend, APIs, supabase/, or middleware. Reuse existing theme tokens from globals.css. Preserve existing visibility logic in WelcomeModal exactly. The modal's Escape key close, checkbox localStorage logic, and controlled/uncontrolled open mode must all be preserved.
key_patterns: 1. Tailwind v4 CSS-first: tokens live in globals.css @theme block and :root/:light CSS vars. Use `bg-accent`, `text-accent-text`, `border-accent-border`, `bg-accent-soft`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-card`, `border-border`, `text-foreground` in className — never hardcode hex. 2. `cn()` from @/components/shared/cn for class merging. 3. next/image `<Image>` with explicit width/height or fill. 4. Button component at components/ui/Button.tsx — variant='primary' renders the gold accent pill. 5. Animations: globals.css defines `animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95` keyframes (g-enter, g-enter-scale). 6. All logo images currently use `/image/wc/logo.png` — this is the OLD path to replace with `/image/Logo/GroovePH-Logo.png`. 7. WelcomeModal logo will use `/image/Logo/welcome-Logo.png` (a different dedicated logo). 8. Metadata icons in app/layout.tsx use the public-root favicon files.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router pages and layouts; components/ — React components organized by domain (shared/, ui/, coach/, client/, admin/, theme/); public/ — static assets (image/Logo/ has the two new logos, image/wc/logo.png is the old logo); lib/ — Supabase clients and utilities; features/ — domain feature modules; globals.css defines all CSS tokens (no tailwind.config.ts — pure CSS-first Tailwind v4)
